say:1:1631339001:2.text: Ah! The Dawnbringer Sword! Just as legendary as the legends say!
say:1:1631339001:2.source_cn: 啊！破晓圣剑，果然像传说中一样轻盈！
say:1:1631339001:2.male: Ah! The Dawnbringer Sword! Just as legendary as the legends say!
say:1:1631339001:2.female: Ah! The Dawnbringer Sword! Just as legendary as the legends say!

say:2:1631339002:2.text: And my valiant steed, Ronar III! Hear his mighty hooves as he gallops!
say:2:1631339002:2.source_cn: 还有我矫健的神驹，罗纳尔三世！听，它坚实的蹄声！
say:2:1631339002:2.male: And my valiant steed, Ronar III! Hear his mighty hooves as he gallops!
say:2:1631339002:2.female: And my valiant steed, Ronar III! Hear his mighty hooves as he gallops!

say:3:1631339003:2.text: And this fearless helmet. No enemy can touch me now!
say:3:1631339003:2.source_cn: 再戴上这顶无畏头盔，任何敌人都无法再伤到我！
say:3:1631339003:2.male: And this fearless helmet. No enemy can touch me now!
